exposure: Gestational trophoblastic neoplasia (GTN) located in the cesarean scar
outcome: Clinical characteristics of GTN located in the cesarean scar
cohort: Women diagnosed with GTN located in the cesarean scar at Peking Union Medical College Hospital, Beijing, China, between June 1, 2006, and May 31, 2016
finding: GTN located in the cesarean scar is rare and prone to misdiagnosis due to its nonspecific symptoms, often requiring pathology for definitive diagnosis.
